title: Entrepreneur Rebuilds Beauty Brand: Nurse turns $500 into $100m; now backs Watch & Sea
summary_full: Courtney Adeleye made a remarkable shift from nursing to entrepreneurship by founding The Mane Choice, a haircare brand that achieved impressive success. Initially starting with a few products, the overwhelming demand prompted the addition of supplements, accelerating the brand's growth. Ultimately, The Mane Choice surpassed $100 million in annual sales, culminating in its acquisition for $61.5 million in 2019.
